prompt: University students often focus on one subject. However, some people think that universities should encourage students to learn a range of other subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In modern life, there are some universites provide one subject to be considered. However, some people believe that colleges should encourage students to learn varied subjects. I firmly agree with the concept of studying one course. In this essay, an attempt will be made to examine both views carefully.

On the one hand, studying a range of subjects plays a vital role in people's lives, as it helps people to learn about widespread topics simultaneously. However, since we are talking about learning from educational institutions, it is crucial to give full concentration to a particular subject. Colleges have limited time for learning and gaining experience at the same time, it is important to dedicate this time properly. For example, if someone wants to learn a specific material theoretically and practically, he has to use his time in an appropriate way because time is limited. As a result, there will be a full experience from this learning method.

On the other hand, it is difficult to learn multiple curricula at university for those who want to  specialise in their field of study. Although there will be a plan for these courses, it may confuse students, especially those who want to be specialised. For instance, students who devote their effort to one specific major are more likely to be highly skilled in their field of study. This approach leads them to succeed in their career, and they can contribute effectively to the community.

In conclusion, focusing on a particular field of study is better than studying for multiple courses due to the confusion and distraction that may appear in the learning journey.
